designUnit.definition: 当前正面身体基准的可见发冠至赤脚地面；含发量，不含护目镜和鞋底。

definitions.total: 刀尖至柄尾端点的直线距离；分段接缝向该长轴投影。
definitions.segments: Each central seam station projected onto straight tip-to-pommel axis; five non-overlapping axial segments sum to total. Blade/guard contact seam is blade root. Curved guard wing envelope measured separately. Grip means visible exterior part, not proven functional grip.
definitions.frontWidth: 刀身与握柄宽取垂直长轴的同一截面；护手总横向跨度单列为翼形外包宽，不混用两种量法。
definitions.thickness: 正面母版只显示两把匕首的正面，没有窄侧视；刀身侧厚和握柄侧深均未测，值为 null。
definitions.measurementUncertainty: 正面母版的端点估读约±2px、接缝约±4px、距离约±4px、段长约±8px、截宽约±3px。携行背面图的整刀端点估读约±4原生px，局部刀身截线边缘约±3px；配准锚点分别记录容差。两者各按自己的原生像素计，均为图面估读范围，不是统计置信区间。
definitions.bodyAlignment: H0 取正面身体图的可见发冠至赤脚地面，人物画布大小、护目镜高度和鞋底均不能代替 H0。人物图须有身体配准才能比较图面读数与设计目标。

designTargets.meaning: 整长设计目标为墨黑 0.2246 H0、骨白 0.2633 H0；细分按双匕首尺寸母版的可见轴向段与截宽占整长比例，分别归一到每把刀的整长。

sourceObservations.method: Same tip-to-pommel axis and seam-midpoint convention as observed-current-dagger-proportions.json. Width is same-station perpendicular section; guard is total transverse envelope. No curved arc length.

referenceBasis.meaning: 照片投影仅启发尺寸方向；Bunny 的整长设计目标为墨黑 0.2246 H0、骨白 0.2633 H0，不是原作武器真实长度。

carryingDesign.definition: 设计要求：挂片上沿翻过皮带，在皮带下沿缝死；片上开一条与刀身垂直的窄口，长度正好等于刀身宽度，限制刀转动，使刀尖至柄尾端点的直线停在相对水平向外上方 28°；握柄方向另行读取，角度更陡。刀身从正面穿过窄口，到挂片后面贴着短裤，全部露在外面；护手卡在窄口，刀的重量压在护手上；按扣带压住刀柄根部，防止跑跳时刀向上脱出；取刀时先打开按扣，再沿握柄方向向外上方抽出。
carryingDesign.visibleAppearance: 图面可见：两把匕首不带鞘，挂在背后的裤腰皮带上；后中裤袢两侧各有一片黑色皮挂片，每把握柄在红领上方各绕一条黑短带，各有一颗圆形银按扣。两把刀柄朝上、朝外，墨黑匕首在角色右侧，柄尾朝角色右上方；骨白匕首在角色左侧，柄尾朝角色左上方；裸露刀身向对侧延伸，在后腰浅交叉成 X，交叉处骨白在外。

newMountMeasurements.meaning: Native back-image observations: the 28 degree target uses the tip-to-pommel-end chord above horizontal. Orange pommel mark to red collar defines a separate, steeper observed grip direction; construction grip angles are not owner-decided values.

carryingDesign.note: 正面腰旁露出两把柄尾，画面左侧臀旁露出骨白刀尖，中段被身体遮挡，不测完整刀长。角色右侧面在袖缘后可见黑色握柄块、红领和银色圆扣，上方露出骨白柄尾尖端与橙标；腰后可见窄刀身投影。遮挡和叠合不支持重建整刀长度或侧厚。T姿正面可见腰两侧柄尾与画面左侧骨白尖端；背面可见骨白在外的浅 X 交叉及挂片、按扣带；两侧面可见柄尾、固定带与窄刃投影。T姿仅记录可见性，不据此推整刀数值。人物背面两刀端点均可见，所列长度和角度是该图的二维估读，不是3D尺寸验收。

carryingDesign.crossingAngleDefinition: Acute crossing angle of the two complete tip-to-pommel projected chords, not a physical 3D crossing angle.

dark.method: Each dagger normalized by its own locked total length; no image pixels are scaled. Intervals propagate source endpoint/seam/width reading bounds and are not statistical confidence intervals.

ivory.method: Each dagger normalized by its own locked total length; no image pixels are scaled. Intervals propagate source endpoint/seam/width reading bounds and are not statistical confidence intervals.

currentDimensions.meaning: The current front master defines exterior part proportions. Fixed total lengths are design choices; blade thickness and grip depth are unmeasured.

artworkAcceptanceRecord.status: final4k-artwork-native-observations; projection readings are not dimensional acceptance

observations.method: Native-pixel outline and visible colour-region reading. Positive uniform scale plus translation fitted body-back to daggers-back from three explicitly reread visible anchors; no rotation or axis stretch. Hair and knee marks are drawing proxies, not anatomical joints.

anchors.name: right visible hair-crown peak; not equipment
central lowest occipital hair-tip outline; not a neck bone
upper apex of inner right-knee shadow; not a joint centre

observations.sensitivity_semantics: 4096 source/target x/y tolerance-box corner fits, all three anchors included. Sensitivity envelope, not a statistical confidence interval.

dark.axis_definition: Straight visible tip-to-pommel-end chord above horizontal; this is the 28 degree design-target axis. It is separate from the steeper grip direction.
dark.visibility: Both terminal vertices visible in this native back image.

visible_blade_axis.method: Midpoints of two fully visible vertical sections at the specified native x coordinates; y contour centres approximately +/-3 pixels.
visible_blade_axis.whole_blade_axis_limit: Curved outline and partly covered root do not establish one unique straight whole-blade centreline.

grip_direction.definition: Centre of visible orange pommel mark to centre of red collar, independently read in native pixels.
grip_direction.method: Visible colour regions and collar outline centre; +/-3 pixels per x/y centre coordinate; all endpoint-box corners enumerated.
grip_direction.target_comparison: Observed grip direction is distinct from the 28 degree chord target; no owner-decided grip angle is asserted.
grip_direction.construction_comparison: Construction used collar/grip seam to grip/pommel seam; orange-mark-to-collar is a different span in this drawing, so its angle is recorded independently.

checker_comparison.explanation: Endpoint outline-centre reading differs by 1-2 native pixels; body-back fit gives H0 3099.28 px versus checker proxy 1355*2352/1024 = 3112.265625 px. Both differences are below the requested thresholds.

ivory.axis_definition: Straight visible tip-to-pommel-end chord above horizontal; this is the 28 degree design-target axis. It is separate from the steeper grip direction.
ivory.visibility: Both terminal vertices visible in this native back image.

visible_blade_axis.method: Midpoints of two fully visible vertical sections at the specified native x coordinates; y contour centres approximately +/-3 pixels.
visible_blade_axis.whole_blade_axis_limit: Curved outline and partly covered root do not establish one unique straight whole-blade centreline.

grip_direction.definition: Centre of visible orange pommel mark to centre of red collar, independently read in native pixels.
grip_direction.method: Visible colour regions and collar outline centre; +/-3 pixels per x/y centre coordinate; all endpoint-box corners enumerated.
grip_direction.target_comparison: Observed grip direction is distinct from the 28 degree chord target; no owner-decided grip angle is asserted.
grip_direction.construction_comparison: Construction used collar/grip seam to grip/pommel seam; orange-mark-to-collar is a different span in this drawing, so its angle is recorded independently.

observations.mount_position_semantics: Approximate visible regions only; polygons trace observable fragments/envelopes, not concealed complete tab shapes.
observations.back_tab_slit_observation: 黑挂片与刀根、护手相叠，局部刀根被黑挂片遮挡；图中没有可独立辨认、与刀身垂直的窄口轮廓。可见遮挡不能证明完整穿入路径或窄口尺寸。

supersedes.reason: Marked-evidence QA found the preliminary snap points at the upper silver edges. Silver-region centroids and full circular outlines put the centres at (1010,1267) and (1314,1279), +/-3px. Every earlier evidence file is retained without overwriting.

snap_centre_reading.method: Native silver-region segmentation in isolated snap ROIs, visually checked against the circular outlines; threshold sensitivity 140/180/210. These locate colour regions, not hidden attachment centres.

figureObservations.meaning: 人物背面整刀弦长约墨黑 0.228 H0、骨白 0.259 H0；端点各约 ±4 px，身体配准与端点合并估读范围约为 0.219–0.237 H0／0.249–0.269 H0，包含各自整长设计目标。刀尖至柄尾直线相对水平约 26.9°／28.9°，28° 目标按此直线定义；柄尾橙标中心至红领中心另读约 34.8°／42.5°，各中心约 ±3 px。柄方向更陡，属于图面观察，不是所有者另定的角度。曲刃局部轴、整刀弦与柄方向分别记录；二维投影不验收3D尺寸。

definitionProcessCommentary.thickness: 当前母版只有两把匕首的正面，没有窄侧视；刀身侧厚和握柄侧深尚未测定，当前值为null，不作为已验收尺寸。
definitionProcessCommentary.measurementUncertainty: 正面母版的估读记录为端点±2px、接缝±4px、距离约±4px、段长约±8px、宽约±3px。4K携行背图的独立图面估读为：整刀端点约±4原生px；局部刀身截线边缘约±3px；配准锚点分别记录容差。均为图面估读范围，不是统计置信区间，不把母版容差移植给人物图。
definitionProcessCommentary.bodyAlignment: 人物画布大小、护目镜高度或鞋底不得直接代替H0。姿势投影不改变设计目标，没有身体配准的图面不标为尺寸通过。

auditNotes.mountBoardPixelEvidence: 挂法近景原生 3520×2352：骨白侧挂片顶端约 y777、邻接皮带 x1480 处约 y805–959；墨黑侧挂片顶端约 y779、邻接皮带 x2010 处约 y804–958。轮廓容差各约 ±6 px；银扣中心分别约 (1135,918)、(2288,935)，各约 ±4 px。仅是可见高差，未证明翻折、缝合或窄口路径。
auditNotes.backTabSlitEvidence: 黑挂片与刀根、护手相叠，局部刀根被黑挂片遮挡；图中没有可独立辨认、与刀身垂直的窄口轮廓。可见遮挡不能证明完整穿入路径或窄口尺寸。
